reviews.x: Responsive company; they kept me informed when the product shipped.  The loofah pads are high quality and easy to use.  A great value with a 4-pack, which will last quite awhile.  I especially like the cloth strap which is soft; it works just like a washcloth with a strap to keep it from falling off your hand.  The loop is handy; when I'm done I just hang it on my shower attachment and it's dry for the next time.  I highly recommend this product and will buy again.

reviews.t: just enough scratch for normal skin. feels greeeeeat
reviews.x: i look forward to showers with this scrubby. not too much and not too little on the coarseness. just right to scrub off the dead skin and make you feel soft and glow. plus you get 4 for cheap so you dont have to feel guilty throwing them away when you want a clean one. they do not wear out quickly even with wringing them out.

This worked well to exfoliate for smooth skin. I have a little bit of chicken skin on my arms and after some time of daily exfoliation, my arms are smooth now. It can be a bit rough but it works well.
Item exactly as described. Makes my skin extra smooth. Will buy again

reviews.t: Great Loofah Pads - Skin feels amazing!!
reviews.x: We just received the latest Loofah pads from Lulu Essentials and we love them! I know that you can't get too excited about loofahs, but these new pads are pretty awesome. The elastic band fits right on my hand and makes body washing that much better. My skin feels smoother and refreshed after the shower with a gentle exfoliation. Great product and we'll definitely be ordering these again when the time comes! Thanks Lulu Essentials!

I have very sensitive and delicate skin. I was a bit apprehensive at first about paying so much, but them I reminded myself “You get what you pay for” and did I ever! They are actually quite big so if you have big hands, they won’t be a problem at all! I have small dainty hands, and they work fine just for me also! Reallt love how you get 4 of them all well! These really are high quality and will be buying again in the future!

Got these because I wanted something more exfoliating than a plastic shower pouf and I was tired of the agave fiber wash cloths I had been using.  So far but it scrubs well, rinses well, and the little loop to hang it and stretchy handle are both handy features.  The loofah part puffs up once it's hydrated--it's like half a loofah, easier to use than getting a whole natural loofah.  I've only been using this for less than a month, but it's held up well and the construction seems sturdy.

reviews.t: It’s a good loofah option for the shower.
reviews.x: I bought these to replace my old plastic loofah which was falling apart with a biodegradable option. It’s a bit stiffer than I expected but it’s in line with what a loofah should feel like. It does wonders on my arms and the back of my legs, and places that used to be rough are now smooth. I had to install a hook in my shower to hang it where it would not fall in the floor, because it has such a small hanging hook) but it was worth it.

I don’t know why I have never used a loofah mit before!  But I love this.  I saw the ones that look like balls.  But I wanted something that I could hold easily.  These ones fit the bill!  My skin felt so good after using it (with the goat milk soap I use).  Great value.  When these 4 are ready to be tossed, I will be buying them again!  Thanks for the great product.  Not rough on your skin but exfoliates great!

I've tried a number of different loofah pads and this one is the my favorite so far. The exfoliation works very well without irritating my skin. The elastic doesn't get stretched out. Price was reasonable too.  Will buy again.
I love these loofas. They're a good size, easy to handle, and they do wonders for my dry skin. They arrived nicely packaged too, suitable for a gift. I recommend them.

Exceptional quality natural loofah on an extra-large pad. It puffs up nearly 4X and has just the right amount of roughness to exfoliate and leave your skin soft. I’ll definitely be purchasing these again and would recommend to anyone. They are a bit more pricey than other brands, but worth every penny.

I bought this item first time in 2018 and it was great. Then ordered again in January 2019, and noticed quality was so much worse. Poor quality. Got holes after a week of use. The hanging loop got almost half the size, making it so hard to hang on a shower hook.

" Excellent Loofa pads....very absorbent and constructed. I've used others that have fallen apart in a week. These will last and the texture is the perfect balance of being rougher than a washcloth and not scratching my skin. I will buy them again  "

I wanted something a little more abrasive than the standard shower poof. This fit the bill! I love a good scrub to get rid of dead skin, dirt, and oils trapped in your skin. These do the job for myself and my family.

reviews.t: This was rough on my skin it was like taking a wire sponge to my skin
reviews.x: This was rough on my skin it was like taking a wire sponge to my skin. If your looking to take a layer off your skin this is for you. I would advise buying with caution.
These loofah scrubs are AMAZING. I really like the handle on them, and the amount you get. Very affordable price for the value and quality you get. Feels great!
Thank you for quick delivery. Love my new loofahs!

reviews.t: Too hard and rigid for me
reviews.x: I did not like these loofahs. I was looking to replace the Buf-Puf Double-Sided Body Sponge I use because although I love it it is a bit pricey. The price of the loufas are really good but these were too hard and rigid for me even when wet and with plenty of soap. I gave the remaining three to friends to try as I wouldn't be using the remaining three and they agreed with me and said they were too stiff even when wet.

I usually never leave reviews but these are awful! I made the mistake of giving the first one the benefit of the doubt and using 2 so I can’t return them but they are hard as a rock. Even with continued use and plenty of water and soap, I feel like I’m cleansing myself with a rock. The back strap also snapped off from one. Never buying again. Don’t waste your money.

reviews.t: These are great and just love them for I've been having a ...
reviews.x: These are great and just love them for I've been having a problem with flaky skin lately and these take care of removing it. Would definitely recommend them and will order more when I wear these out which in my estimate will take a while for they are very well crafted.

My first package was quite rough but after leaving a review, I was contacted by the company immediately and offered a refund and complimentary new shipment! So nice! My next shipment was remarkably different - soft but offers lots of exfoliation. Yay!

Purchased these to replace plastic based loofah.  Even after soaking in hot water, the sponge is very rough for sensitive skin. It has softened with use, but not as quickly as I expected.  The elastic band on the backside almost immediately ripped.

I'm very disappointed in these. They are very stiff, and do not bend along your body when you wash. Other reviews say their sponges puffed up after water hit them, mine do not. They are very stiff and don't do the job very well.

reviews.t: The loofah's are great. They puff up nicely after you had water ...
reviews.x: The loofah's are great. They puff up nicely after you add water to them. The only problem I had was the hand loop is too big for my hands so my hand would slip out when I was scrubbing my arms & legs.  It's a great size loofah.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the exfoliating performance, saying the pads leave skin smooth and soft.
Many reviewers describe the texture as having just the right amount of roughness—effective without being too harsh.
Reviewers commonly call the 4-pack a great value and say they would buy again.
Several reviewers highlight the elastic strap/handle and hanging loop as handy, easy-to-hold features.
A few reviewers note the pads are stiffer or rougher than expected, and one reports poor durability with holes after a week.
